meta.homeTitle: Fivvi: software for personal trainers, studios and gyms
meta.homeDescription: Fivvi is being built with its first gym: calendar, bookings, credits, payments and invoices in one place. Book a demo to see what's ready.

logo.homeLabel: Fivvi, go to the home page

home.headline: You train.
home.lead: We're building one place for calendar, bookings, credits, payments and invoices: made for personal trainers, studios and gyms, and a pleasure for their clients.
home.status: Fivvi is being built right now, together with our first gym. Ask in the demo what's ready.
home.seeFor: See what Fivvi does for you

gym.short: Soon one calendar for all your trainers, and always a clear view of who still has to pay.

studio.short: Soon full classes, a tidy waitlist and clients who book themselves.

pt.short: Soon your whole day fits in your pocket: who's coming, what you did last time and what's left.

client.short: Soon you book your class in a few taps and always see what's on your balance.

onePlace.heading: Your business lives in five places.
onePlace.lead: Every separate tool is a place where something can go wrong. In Fivvi everything will be connected, so there will be nothing to retype.
onePlace.app: A separate booking and payment app

chain.heading: One booking. Everything adds up.
chain.lead: Try the sample. It shows how we're building it: book the class and watch what happens by itself.

pack.title: Credit pack
pack.text: Lisa buys 10 group credits and pays with iDEAL.

payment.title: Payment
payment.text: The money goes straight to the studio, not through Fivvi.

invoice.title: Invoice
invoice.text: The invoice follows the payment by itself.

booking.title: Booking
booking.text: She books herself, and one credit is planned.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.text: The trainer ticks her off in the app.

balance.title: Balance
balance.text: Lisa and the owner see the same balance.

card.title: Timetable · Reformer
card.confirmBody: This uses 1 group credit, leaving you {left}. You can cancel for free up to 12 hours before.
card.say1: Booked. One credit is planned and comes back if she cancels in time.
card.say2: Attended. The credit is used, and nobody had to keep track.

forWhom.heading: Your day looks different. So does Fivvi.
forWhom.lead: We're building Fivvi to show only what you do. An independent trainer never sees group classes. A yoga studio never sees workout screens.

platforms.heading: At home on every screen.
platforms.lead: These screens show what we're building. The apps for iPhone and Android are coming, with iOS glass and the Android style, and in your browser you'll find the same calm.

proIphone.title: Fivvi Pro on iPhone
proIphone.text: Your day, clients and workouts, always at hand.

proAndroid.title: Fivvi Pro on Android
proAndroid.text: Everything the iPhone does, the Android way.

proLaptop.title: Fivvi on your laptop
proLaptop.text: Offers, trainers, payments and invoices on a big screen, with what needs attention at the top.

clientIphone.title: Fivvi on iPhone
clientIphone.text: Your next class, this week and your balance on one screen.

clientAndroid.title: Fivvi on Android
clientAndroid.text: The same app, the Android way.

clientBrowser.title: Fivvi in your browser
clientBrowser.text: No app needed: book through your studio's link.

money.title: The money will go straight to you
money.text: You'll connect your own Mollie account in one guided step. Fivvi will never hold client money.

cash.title: Cash or card will be fine too
cash.text: You'll be able to record a payment outside Fivvi on the client's profile. Skipping Mollie will be possible too; Fivvi will first tell you what you'd miss.

notes.title: Notes will stay with the trainer
notes.text: Trainer notes will be for trainers only. Clients won't see them.

amounts.title: Trainers won't see amounts
amounts.text: A trainer will see clients' balances, but no money. Owners will see the amounts too.

noApp.title: Clients won't need an app
noApp.text: Clients will join with a link or QR code, their email address and a 6-digit code. No password.

languages.title: Dutch and English
languages.text: Everything exists in both languages, and everyone chooses their own.

home.fictional: All examples on this site are fictional.

audience.dayLead: A working day as we're building it. Every problem gets an answer, and that answer is a screen from our design. Most of it is still coming; the demo shows what's ready.

gyms.metaTitle: Software for gyms with a team | Fivvi
gyms.metaDescription: We're building one calendar for all your trainers, proper roles and payments that run by themselves. See a working day in Fivvi.
gyms.headline: Your team, your clients and your money in one view.
gyms.lead: Soon you can replace the separate calendar, the booking app and the handmade invoices with one place your whole gym runs on.

pains.one: Trainers share a client login, or work from their own calendar.
pains.two: Nobody knows exactly how many sessions a client has left.
pains.three: Invoices and direct debits eat up your evening.

crew.question: Three trainers at work at once. Who's where?
crew.answer: Whole studio gives each trainer their own lane, and names the busiest moment of your day.

ticks.a: Sessions side by side, no puzzling
ticks.b: On your phone and your laptop

attention.question: What needs attention today?
attention.answer: The dashboard lines it up for you: an open payment, a pack running out, a membership ending.

ticks.a: Nothing to search or keep track of

team.question: A new trainer. What can they see?
team.answer: Trainers get their own team access, never a client account. They see their calendar and balances, but no amounts.

ticks.a: Change role: trainer or owner
ticks.b: Someone leaving? You see the next 2 weeks and hand them over

substitute.question: Tonight's class has lost its trainer.
substitute.answer: Put a substitute on the class and you're done. The same page shows who's coming and who's on the waitlist.

ticks.a: Attendance per participant

offers.question: Your prices live in a spreadsheet.
offers.answer: Offers keeps your memberships, credit packs and credit plans together. You start with three ready-made plans: add a price, switch one on.

ticks.a: A change only applies to new memberships and packs
ticks.b: Clients only see what's switched on

payments.question: Clients pay late, and you send the reminder.
payments.answer: Connect Mollie in one guided step. Clients pay with iDEAL, after that it runs monthly by itself, and the invoice follows.

ticks.a: The money goes straight to your account
ticks.b: A payment fails? You and the client hear about it

renewal.question: A membership ends, and nobody noticed.
renewal.answer: Fivvi reminds the client itself, twice, with one-tap renewal. You see it on the client's profile and can always send an offer yourself.

ticks.a: No gap and no overlap when it renews

studios.metaTitle: Booking system for pilates and yoga studios | Fivvi
studios.metaDescription: We're building a timetable clients book themselves, a waitlist that runs by itself and credits that always add up. In your studio's own words.
studios.headline: Your classes are full. Your head isn't.
studios.lead: We're building a timetable clients book themselves, credits that always add up and a waitlist that runs by itself. In your studio's own words.

pains.one: The class is full, and the messages keep coming.
pains.two: Ten-class cards on paper or in a spreadsheet.
pains.three: Gym software that doesn't understand your studio.

waitlist.question: {spots} spots, and everyone wants half past six.
waitlist.answer: Clients book themselves from the timetable. When the class is full, they get the waitlist, with their position shown.

ticks.a: Booking always asks for confirmation
ticks.b: No more messages back and forth

credits.question: How many classes are left on her card?
credits.answer: Credits per kind: used, planned and left. The client sees the same as you.

ticks.a: Group and private credits never mix
ticks.b: Cancelling in time gives the credit back

substitute.question: Your {who} calls in sick.
substitute.answer: Put a substitute on the class. Clients keep booking and the class stays on.

ticks.a: The same page shows who's coming

level.question: Beginners in an advanced class.
level.answer: Give each class a level and a description, in Dutch and English. So everyone picks the right class.

ticks.a: Beginner, intermediate, advanced or all levels

word.question: We don't say trainer.
word.answer: Choose your own word: trainer, instructor, teacher or coach. All of Fivvi then speaks like your studio. And a yoga studio with only classes sees no workout screens.

ticks.a: Fivvi only shows what you do

poster.question: A new client at the desk. Now what?
poster.answer: Print the A4 poster with your QR code, in two languages. Scan, sign up, you approve, done.

ticks.a: No app needed to book
ticks.b: In colour or black and white

personalTrainers.metaTitle: Software for personal trainers: calendar and workouts | Fivvi
personalTrainers.metaDescription: We're building your day, clients, workouts and credits on your phone. Without screens you don't use.
personalTrainers.headline: Train your client. Not your admin.
personalTrainers.lead: Soon everything for your sessions on your phone, even in the middle of the floor. Without the group classes or team screens you'd never use.

pains.one: Your calendar, notes and invoices are all over the place.
pains.two: You work out how many sessions a client has left.
pains.three: After a long day, the admin is still waiting.

today.question: Where do you need to be again?
today.answer: Today shows your day in one line, and below it who, when and where. Working in several places? You'll see today's route.

ticks.a: Your next free gap is ready to plan

last.question: What did we do last time?
last.answer: Open the client and you see the last workout, what was hard, your own note and progress per exercise.

ticks.a: Notes are for you only

log.question: You log on paper, or not at all.
log.answer: One row per set with last time's value next to it. Tick it off, and mark how hard each exercise was.

ticks.a: Made to use with one hand
ticks.b: Save it as a template for next time

credits.question: How many sessions does she have left?
credits.answer: No sums: before the session you already see if credits are running out, or if a payment is still open.

ticks.a: Used, planned and left

duo.question: Two friends want to train together.
duo.answer: A duo session: one trainer, two clients, each with their own workout, credit and attendance.

ticks.a: Switch between the two while logging

share.question: Your client wants to know what she did today.
share.answer: Share the workout with one message. Your client sees every exercise and can redo it on their own.

ticks.a: No more screenshots in a chat

clients.metaTitle: Book your class in a few taps | Fivvi for clients
clients.metaDescription: Soon you can book, join the waitlist and always see your balance, with the app or just in your browser.
clients.headline: Working out is hard enough. Booking isn't.
clients.lead: Soon you can ask your studio or trainer for Fivvi, and book from your phone from then on. Always clear what you've booked and what you have left.

pains.one: Sending a message to book a class.
pains.two: No idea how many classes are left on your card.
pains.three: A different app for every studio.

book.question: Quickly book a class on the train.
book.answer: Open the timetable and tap Book. You don't even need an app: the browser is enough, and the app makes it nicer.

ticks.a: Sign in with an emailed code, no password

confirm.question: Does this use a credit? How many do I have?
confirm.answer: Before you confirm, you see the class, the day and the trainer, which credit it uses, how many you'll have left and until when you can cancel for free.

ticks.a: Cancelling in time gives your credit back

waitlist.question: Full. Of course.
waitlist.answer: Put yourself on the waitlist and see your position right away.

ticks.a: Leaving the list is fine too

week.question: Am I actually going often enough?
week.answer: This week shows when you went and what's still planned, plus how many weeks in a row you've kept it up.

ticks.a: Just facts, no goals someone else made up

self.question: Your trainer's workout, but now in your own gym.
self.answer: Open the shared workout and do it yourself, with your trainer's weights filled in. Adding or removing exercises is fine.

ticks.a: Only you see this workout

studios.question: Pilates here, yoga there.
studios.answer: One account for all your studios. Switch with one tap and see your balance per studio.

ticks.a: Home and calendar combine all your studios

renew.question: Your credits are almost gone.
renew.answer: You get a heads-up in time, and renew in one tap with iDEAL. After that, the notice is gone.

ticks.a: Your invoice is in your profile

cta.heading: What does your day look like in Fivvi?
cta.text: Book a demo. We'll show Fivvi with your kind of business, and you'll know right away if it fits.

pricing.metaDescription: Fivvi is free during the pilot. No subscription and no fee per client.
pricing.headline: Free during the pilot.
pricing.lead: Fivvi costs nothing right now: no subscription and no fee per client.
pricing.includedLabel: What will be included, as we build it

included.pro: Fivvi Pro for you and your trainers
included.workouts: Logging and sharing workouts, once that's ready

payments.question: What does it cost to take payments?
payments.answer: Online payments are coming. To let clients pay online, you'll use your own Mollie account. Mollie charges an amount per payment, at their rates. You'll pay that to Mollie, not to Fivvi. If you only take cash or card, you won't need Mollie.

clients.question: What do my clients pay?
clients.answer: Only what you charge. The app and the website will be free for them.

later.question: And if Fivvi starts charging later?
later.answer: You'll hear at least 60 days in advance. You can then stop for free and take your data with you. You never pay for anything you didn't agree to first.

pricing.currency: All amounts are in euros. Because you don't pay Fivvi anything right now, there are no payment terms.

support.metaDescription: Frequently asked questions and how to reach us.
support.headline: Help and contact
support.lead: Feel free to email us. We're happy to help, and we reply within 2 working days.

join.question: How do I join my studio?
join.answer: This is coming. Your studio or trainer will give you a link or a QR code. Open it, enter your email address, then the 6-digit code you receive. Your studio approves your request and then you can book.

noCode.question: I don't get a code. What now?
noCode.answer: Check your spam and your email address. A code is valid for 15 minutes. After that, just ask for a new one.

cancel.question: How do I cancel a class?
cancel.answer: Cancelling is coming. You'll open the class and choose Cancel. If you're in time, you'll get your credit back. Your studio decides how long that's possible.

invoices.question: Where do I find my invoices?
invoices.answer: Invoices are coming. You'll find them in Profile, under Invoices, and you'll be able to download them there too.

deleteAccount.question: How do I delete my account?
deleteAccount.answer: Email {address} from your account's address with the subject Delete account. We'll do it within one month and let you know.

payments.question: How do I connect payments?
payments.answer: Connecting payments is coming. You'll go to Settings, Payments, Connect payments on your laptop. Mollie checks your details. iDEAL will work first; automatic direct debit takes up to about 3 working days longer.

mollie.question: Do I have to use Mollie?
mollie.answer: No. Payments are not in Fivvi yet. Once they are, taking only cash or card will be fine: Fivvi will first tell you what you'd miss, and you can connect Mollie later.

devices.question: Which devices does Fivvi work on?
devices.answer: Fivvi Pro is coming for iPhone and Android. You do the admin in the browser on your laptop, where the first parts are ready. Clients will use the app or their browser.

data.question: Where is my data stored?
data.answer: The database is in Amsterdam. Some services are from US companies, with the safeguards the law requires. They're listed under Sub-processors. Notes will be for trainers only.

privacy.metaDescription: Which personal data Fivvi processes, why, for how long, and which rights you have.
privacy.headline: Privacy policy

subProcessors.metaDescription: The services that process data for Fivvi, what for, and where they store it.
subProcessors.headline: Sub-processors
subProcessors.lead: These services process data for Fivvi. Railway, Sentry and PostHog are US companies; the privacy policy explains the safeguards. When a new service is added, we tell every studio first.

purpose.railway: Hosting the website, apps and database
purpose.lettermint: Emails, such as your sign-in code and confirmations
purpose.zoho: Our own mailbox for questions, privacy requests and demo requests
purpose.sentry: Error reports, without names, email addresses or notes

subProcessors.mollie: Mollie processes payments under its own agreement with your studio.

demo.metaDescription: See what's ready in Fivvi, and how your working week will look, in 30 minutes.
demo.headline: See Fivvi with your day in it.
demo.lead: 30 minutes, online. No sales pitch: we show what's ready and how your own working week will look in Fivvi.

tell.title: You tell us how it works now
tell.body: Which apps, lists and messages do you use today?

show.title: We show your kind of business
show.body: Gym, studio or personal trainer: you only see what fits you.

fit.title: You know right away if it fits
fit.body: And if so, how you can join the pilot.
